newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates crash on surplus funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates crash on surplus funds.

text.p: The Pakistani money market rates crashed on Saturday owing to surplus funds in the banking system, closing at 1.00 percent compared to Friday's 8.00 percent, dealers said.
"As expected, the overnight market crashed and closed at 1.00 percent," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Major amounts were dealt between 5.00 and 7.00 percent but the rates dropped to 1.00 percent at the close as lenders looked for bids in the absence of borrowing interest, he said.
The week closed with surplus funds, the dealer said.
